messages:
maria: starting a short thread to align on a small 'Querybook' feature: saved per-route/per-model queries in console that show routing hints + quick quota peeks. want API + UX agreement before mocks land. :wave:

alex: sounds good. constraint: list must stay fast. we can't compute detailed quota for every saved query row. propose a cached cheap estimate in list, full calc in a modal on demand. :thinking:

devon: agree. telemetry noise means estimates are fuzzy. show 'est. tokens (7d median)' inline and a "Quota details" button for precise calc with a link to the exact job/log.

kai: API question: snapshot routing decisions on save (pinned_model + fallback list + routing_policy_ref) or compute routing at read-time? snapshot gives reproducibility but can drift.

alex: prefer snapshot with a `stale_pin` flag. reproducibility is valuable for audits. we can surface a subtle badge when pin is missing from the catalog.

maria: +1 for snapshots. also need clear tooltip copy explaining estimates are sampled and may differ from live billing. devon can draft copy.

devon: will do. include sampling rate and a link to telemetry docs. also UX idea: flame icon for high-cost saved-queries in list; hover shows contributing model assumptions. quick triage.

kai: migration: add snapshot field; backfill expensive. plan: async backfill for hot queries (feature-flagged job), read-time server-eval fallback if snapshot missing. allow enterprise to request full backfill.

alex: i'll draft API PR adding `snapshot`, `routing_policy_ref`, `stale_pin`, and `estimated_tokens_cache`. include migration notes.

sam-bot: deploy-bot: CI green for branch adding saved-query snapshot. integration tests passed. :white_check_mark:

maria: action items: alex -> open API PR; kai -> sketch migration job & cache endpoint; devon -> tooltip copy and mock text; i'll add a short spec to sync. rollout gating: org-level flags for enterprise, % rollout for public (start 10%).

alex: will open PR today and include a lightweight schema example. ping me to pair on the migration job.

devon: one more UX note: in the saved-query detail modal, show pinned model, fallback list, and a small 'recompute routing' button for power users.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone, i'll update the spec and tag you.

sam-bot: reminder: weekly-api-standup 2pm today, added this to agenda.
